answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making privilege depend on proven work rather than cheap registration. Each newcomer locks collateral, takes unpredictable tasks, and earns signatures from reviewers outside its cluster. A basalt layer of bonded history must settle before any vote counts, a tide of reputation rises only with consistent results, and a cipher binds each claim to its author so clones are traceable. Audits slash faked records, keeping swarms costly.
